purpose: Agent workflow for triaging vendor security/privacy questionnaires before response drafting.

input_schema.questionnaire_text: string or structured list of questions

suggested_owners.owner: security | legal | privacy | IT | product | other

triage_rules: Do not fabricate certifications or control implementation.
Separate questions that can be answered from approved evidence from those requiring internal verification.

Flag questions involving data retention, subprocessors, incident response, encryption, access control, BCP/DR, certifications, penetration tests, AI training/use of customer data, and regulatory commitments.
Mark legal interpretation separately from technical evidence collection.
Prioritize potential deal blockers and missing proof before drafting polished answers.
agent_prompt: Cluster the questions, identify 3-5 likely blockers, identify evidence gaps, suggest internal owners only when context allows, and never answer a control question with an invented commitment.
